description: Read one job listing in full by id: responsibilities, required and preferred qualifications, benefits, compensation, every location, and company context, as readable text with the structured fields alongside. Use it after `search_jobs`; `fetch` returns the same listing as one text document for clients that pair it with `search`. An unknown id, or one whose listing has closed and been removed, returns an error: search again instead of retrying the id. Free.

id.description: The job's id, a UUID, exactly as a search tool returned it.

include_description.description: Append the raw employer description. Usually unnecessary — the extracted fields cover it and the raw text is long and boilerplate-heavy.

name: get_job_details
title: Get full job details
